name: MINJI
quote: I want NewJeans to be like a pair of classic jeans that you never get tired of wearing.
bio: Minji is the reliable, charismatic leader of NewJeans. Known for her deep, charming vocal tone, classic Korean visual aesthetics, and intelligent, warm leadership.

name: HANNI
quote: Music is our way of telling honest stories that stay with people forever.
bio: Hanni is beloved worldwide for her versatile vocals, adorable expressions, songwriting skills (wrote lyrics for Hype Boy & OMG), and energetic stage presence.

name: HAERIN
quote: Finding quiet focus on stage is when I feel most connected with Bunnies.
bio: Haerin is famous for her iconic feline visuals, precise dance performance, curious personality, and unique vocal colors that give NewJeans its distinctive Y2K flair.

name: HYEIN
quote: Every melody we sing is a gift filled with all our heart for our Bunnies.
bio: Hyein is the multi-talented youngest member (maknae). Standing tall with high-fashion model proportions, her soulful R&B vocals and mature performance captivate fans.

name: DANIELLE
quote: Forever grateful for every single smile and warm memory shared with Bunnies.
bio: Danielle contributed immense sunshine energy, expressive vocal range, Disney princess visuals, and artistic lyricism during her memorable era with NewJeans. Note: This profile is preserved as an official member archive.
